title: Rotate the List
story: Move the last k items to the front.
goal: Write rotate(items, k): return a new list rotated right by k places. k may be larger than the length.
hints: k % len(items) removes full turns. Careful with an empty list.
items[-k:] + items[:-k] works when k is between 1 and len - 1.
socratic: What does rotating by the full length do?
What if the list is empty?
Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what is the key idea in “Rotate the List”?
